text:
tom: Quick microcopy review for the inline error on the model dropdown. It currently says "Model not found" which is vague when a model is temporarily unavailable during rollout.
alec: Agreed. We should indicate transient vs permanent. Proposal: "Model unavailable" as the short heading and a second line "Try again in a few seconds or select a different model."
mira: Also add a tooltip link to a short blurb: "Why this happens—models can be temporarily unreachable during rollouts or capacity changes." Keep it <= 120 chars.
accessibility-bot: Accessibility note: inline errors must be in an element with role="alert" so screen readers announce them. If the message changes dynamically, use aria-live="polite". Keep line length reasonable for screen readers.
tom: Wording draft: "Model unavailable
Try again in a few seconds or choose another model.
Learn why →" (link to docs). Use sentence case.
alec: One more nit: avoid imperative "choose"? I think it's fine. Also prefer "Try again in a few seconds" over "Please try again" for brevity.
mira: For localization, avoid contractions and idioms. Final suggested copy keys: `model.error.unavailable.heading`, `model.error.unavailable.body`, `model.error.unavailable.link`.
tom: I'll update Figma with the new error state and drop the copy strings. Thanks! :rocket:
